name: ci-preflight-full-mode-gap
title: CI runs the review preflight only in bookkeeping mode, so a full-mode head merges unvalidated
description: The review preflight's exact-head validation runs only under the bookkeeping classifier mode, so a full-mode head never has its documentation-path, task-metadata, or journal content validated. Full mode does execute the script -- repeatedly in the unittest suite, always against synthetic fixture trees, never against the event head. Demonstrated on PR #358: the same broken reference passed on a full head and failed on the next bookkeeping head.
creator: sdelmas
